expectations.evidence: Project config dir is named 'bookstore/' not 'config/', and apps are at top level not inside 'apps/' directory. Standard Django layout, not Two Scoops.
Single monolithic 'bookstore/settings.py' file. No settings/ directory with base.py, local.py, production.py split.
Three domain-separated apps: accounts (users), books (books+reviews), orders (orders+order items).

expectations.text: 공통 필드를 위한 추상 베이스 클래스를 사용한다
expectations.evidence: created_at/updated_at fields are duplicated across Book, Review, Order models. No abstract base model (e.g., TimeStampedModel) is defined.
books_models.py: rating = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField with MinValueValidator(1) and MaxValueValidator(5)
SECRET_KEY is hardcoded as string literal: 'django-insecure-change-this-in-production'. No os.environ, os.getenv, or django-environ usage.
